title: PAD X RELOAD THEN SEARCH
why: The box said search when combat X would reload and the held button stayed on reload afterwards. The prompt now shares the press decision, including the active reload spot. A completed reload hands the same hold to search; a cancelled reload does not. Revives retain priority and keyboard controls are unchanged. Playtest watch: in both windows, hold X at a box with a partly empty magazine while fighting; see [x] reload, then search when rounds load. Also try a full magazine, no spare rounds and an active reload. The ring keeps its separate Y search prompt.
now: At a box, pad X names reload when it reloads; keep holding to search after it finishes.
